title: The canonical ordinary and ringed module pullback isomorphism
statement: Let l be prime, E/Q_l finite, and f:X→Y a scheme morphism. With completed coefficients [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], define pullbackModuleIso from actual ringed module pullback to the specified ordinaryIntegralModulePull [lem-tw-ordinary-completed-integral-pullback]. Transport the actual ringed adjunction through pullbackPushforwardIso [def-sf-integral-pullback-pushforward-identification], then use uniqueness of left adjoints to compare with the specified ordinary module adjunction. This is a real adjunction construction.

proof.text: Transport the actual ringed module adjunction by the constructed pushforward isomorphism.
Compare its left adjoint with the specified ordinary module adjunction using leftAdjointUniq.

lean.statement:
def pullbackModuleIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    (proEtaleRingModulePullback f ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring Y)
      ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).ring X) ((PurCompactSupport.completed l E).pull f) :
      integralTowerModules l E Y ⥤ integralTowerModules l E X) ≅
      ordinaryIntegralModulePull l E f
